title: Grateful Dead Live at Campolindo High School on 1969-05-16
lineage: Master Soundboard Cassette > Cassette > DAT (speed corrected) > CDR > EAC > SHN

ai_review.summary: A hissy, low‑fidelity gym recording of a shaky high‑school show where Pigpen and Bob Weir provide the few bright spots.
ai_review.review: The tape captures a notoriously ragged Campolindo High School performance – the band sounded unfocused, Jerry was out of tune and even left the stage early, and the sound is plagued by hiss and poor gym acoustics.  A handful of moments shine through (Pigpen’s blues, Bob Weir’s rescuing guitar/vocals and a decent Lovelight), and recent cleanup work makes it marginally listenable.

ai_rating.rationale: Most reviewers criticize both the playing and the audio quality, with only a few noting redeeming moments; the average star rating (~2.9) reflects a below‑average show on a poor‑quality recording.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Very hissy, muffled sound with gym acoustic problems and occasional drop‑outs; some reviewers note that recent restoration improves clarity but the tape remains far from clean.

poor_songs: Hard To Handle (noted as the worst version)
Early set (generally ragged and out of sync)
show_quality.setlist_flow: Short ~50‑minute set cut short by curfew; starts poorly with sloppy playing, improves toward the end as Bob Weir lifts the mood.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Out of tune, lacked passion, even slammed his guitar case and left the stage after being denied a smoke.
band_member_comments.Bob: Saved the concert with bright, creative guitar work and strong vocals; praised as the MVP of the night.
band_member_comments.Drums: Drummers provided some interesting grooves despite occasional timing issues.
